objective: Equal weighted mission mean positive ideal mechanical power, two motors. Ties within 1e-12 W use lower multiplier.
optimized_three_menu: Choose each of three nominal mission grid optima, deduplicate and pad with lowest unused grid multipliers if fewer than three. This reaches the mission per-condition grid oracle because there are only three mission points; no universal optimal-menu claim. On off-design points choose the lowest-work member using declared nominal conditions.

uncertainty.interpretation: Arbitrary conditional scenarios, not identified tolerances or confidence intervals. Policies remain frozen from nominal mission; no knowledge of hidden parameter realization.
uncertainty.drag_factor: exp(0.15*(0.7*z0+sqrt(1-0.7^2)*z1)-0.15^2/2); correlated log factors with air at0.7
uncertainty.spring_damping_ratio: Independent uniform[0,0.05], pair c=2*zeta*sqrt(k_pair*I_effective); wholly hypothetical dissipative burden applied to both fixed and modular springs, c=0 at zero stiffness. Not measured material damping.

sensitivity: OAT±20% rigid inertia, added inertia, drag coefficient, spring calibration. Damping ±20% around explicit scenario zeta=0.025, with its own reference rather than claiming ±20% about nominal zero. Friction/R/Kt remain unavailable and unranked.
detuning_model: Separate harmonic root oscillator theta=A*sin(omega*t), A=24deg, Ieff=reference root+legacy added inertia, Gamma=2*DRAG, kpair=2*reference secant kbar*lambda; f/fn_reference0.6..1.4. Not the actual fourbar. Compare frozen best fixed and menu, without a fabricated target-saving shaded band.
electrical: No motor identification, RMS current, electrical power or equal-lift efficiency computed. Mechanical port eta bounds are not electrical efficiencies.
mass: Reference aircraft41.945526047931395g, four bars0.696014153g, retained matched bookkeeping; selectable hardware mass/process/cost unqualified, no fabricated credit.
